data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Leon, meaning 'lion'. The suffix -ea is a feminine suffix. In Christian mythology, Lynnea may symbolize the strength and courage of a lioness protecting her cubs. The name Lynnea carries the meaning “Lynos's lioness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lynnea usually hope their child will grow to embody lynos's lioness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
